item.title: Minecraft as an Interface for AI Agents | Omo Notes
item.description: Why Minecraft is a useful interface and test world for AI agents: shared space, visible action, persistent consequences, collaboration, and human legibility.

item.title: Voice-First AI Presence: Beyond a Realistic Voice | Omo
item.description: Voice-first AI presence is a turn-taking design problem: latency, interruption, silence, attention, and repair matter more than a realistic synthetic voice alone.

item.title: What Is a Spatial AI Agent? A Working Definition | Omo
item.description: A practical definition of a spatial AI agent: an agent that perceives place, builds spatial memory, acts in an environment, and makes its presence understandable.
